name: Record verified worker identities on Stage Runs
description:
Factory review recommendation 3 of 20.

## Context

Stage Runs are claimed before worker launch and can contain guessed titles rather than real worker identities; ROW-45 exposed a recovery failure.

## Acceptance criteria

- Provide a supported way to attach the actual worker identity after a successful launch.
- Record enough identity information to find the worker after supervisor restart, including machine and harness thread identity.
- Reconcile launch failures and document the lifecycle; amend ADR-0040 through a new repository ADR if required.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor review: Sidecar/attach approach approved in principle; before implementation, coordinate exact common schema with ROW60 and return it for one final interface acceptance. Use run-metadata.json bound to stage/attempt/startedAt and keep legacy bag shape intact except updating worker string through attach. Identity and selection must be independently optional sections so selection can be recorded for a failed launch without an attached worker; same-Run writes preserve the other owner's section. Common file reader/writer belongs to49, selection mutations/policy to60. v1 must not strip unknown/future data; reject unsupported versions and preserve unreadable bytes, report via doctor. Stale metadata must never identify a later Run. Attach expected-Run guard under operation lock, refuse conflicting identity replacement, identical repeats no changes; guard against transforms invalidating the final Run/ref. CLI records supervisor attestation of verification (source/identity), not a claim that Rowbly contacted T3 by itself. Reserve0046. Existing failure/preservation tests; no new test file or >100 total. I am relaying the same boundary to60 now; do not independently design two files/schemas.
